identify: The grub is large and shaped like the letter C.
The head is hard and brown. The grub has three pairs of legs.
damage: The grubs feed on the roots and then on the tubers. They make irregular holes in the potato tubers.

cultural: Do deep ploughing in summer to expose the grubs.
Collect and destroy the white grub beetles from jujube or neem trees around the field after the early rains.
biological: Use entomopathogenic nematodes (EPN) at one billion per acre in infested fields.
